title: Fix: nudge buttons idle-faded (pointer-events:none) while operator was actively viewing history
action: User field-test finding (2026-07-27, after cell -1..-3 and the backend escape-injection-redraw-race fix landed): nudge-up scrolled once successfully, then stopped responding to taps. Root cause: showNudge()'s idle timer (NUDGE_IDLE_MS=3000) fires unconditionally 3s after the last touch/scroll event -- but reading revealed history IS a period of no touch/scroll, so the buttons fade to `.scroll-nudge.is-idle` (styles.css:775-778: opacity:0, pointer-events:none) exactly while the operator is using them, silently swallowing the next tap. Fix: the idle timer now reschedules itself instead of hiding while `viewingHistory` is true, only actually adding `.is-idle` once back at the live bottom.

truths: the scroll-nudge buttons never gain the is-idle class while viewingHistory is true, no matter how long the operator goes without touching/scrolling
idle-hide still resumes normally (after NUDGE_IDLE_MS of no interaction) once back at the live bottom

artifacts.substantive: showNudge()'s idle timer rechecks viewingHistory before hiding, rescheduling instead of hiding while true
regression test: advances past the idle timeout while viewing history (no is-idle), then again after returning to live (is-idle applied)

key_links: reuses the same viewingHistory flag D4's poll-pause already gates on -- no new state
prohibitions: no change to the Reply/Keys sheet hide behavior (updateNudgeVisibility)
